title: NASA/Department of War special investigation of Apollo 17 lights image
summary: Maaneli Derakhshani tells of NASA/Department of War special investigation of Apollo 17 lights image, about 2026 at NASA / Department of War, and reads it from an official document. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: NASA released this image uh in the first trunch, there was a description about it uh next to the image and they say in the description that uh the department of war and NASA have opened an a special investigation for this particular image

plain: A guest named Maaneli Derakhshani told podcast host Jesse Michels about an image of lights from Apollo 17, a 1970s US Moon mission. He says NASA released the image in 2026 as part of the first batch of its files on UAP, the government's newer term for UFOs, and that the description next to it states that NASA and the Department of War, the name now used for the Pentagon, have opened a special investigation into that image. If true, it would mean officials still see something unexplained in a picture from the Moon.
